parity_reason: No criterion differs by more than 1 (background and shape each differ by 1), the totals are 30 and 28 (a difference of 2), and neither image has a critical defect, so all three parity conditions hold.

reference.summary: Santa rides a green kick scooter across a snowy moonlit hill, carrying a stack of presents; the drawing is neat and well made, apart from a few stray shapes.

defects.what: A loose teal curved stroke floats across the presents and Santa's back arm, attached to nothing
defects.where: left side of Santa, over the stack of presents
defects.expected: Every shape around the presents has a clear purpose, such as a visible strap or sack, or it is removed

defects.what: Odd green curved pieces poke out on both sides of the rear wheel and don't read as any part of the scooter
defects.expected: The rear wheel area shows only clear scooter parts, such as a tidy fender, or nothing extra

defects.what: The presents float beside Santa's hip and his rear hand doesn't clearly hold them or support them
defects.where: Santa's left hand and the present stack
defects.expected: Santa is clearly holding or carrying the presents, or they rest on the scooter

defects.what: The arm reaching to the handlebar is very long and stiff compared with the rest of the body
defects.expected: The arm reaching the handlebar has natural proportions for Santa's body

attempt.summary: Santa rides a blue kick scooter on a snowy night hill with stacked presents behind him, under a 'Merry Christmas!' greeting; it reads clearly, but the figure's build is simplified and a bit awkward.

defects.what: Santa's body is a shapeless red blob with thin stick legs, and a separate red arm shape is pasted over one side of his torso
defects.where: Santa's torso, back arm and legs
defects.expected: Santa has a clear, rounded body with an arm and legs that join it naturally

defects.what: The present stack overlaps Santa's back arm and glove, and the upper boxes are jumbled and partly hidden
defects.where: present stack on the back of the deck
defects.expected: The presents form a tidy stack that sits clearly behind or beside Santa without tangling with his arm

defects.what: Santa faces the viewer while riding to the right, so he looks like he is posing rather than steering
defects.expected: Santa is turned toward the direction he rides, steering the scooter

defects.what: The yellow belt buckle hangs below the belt instead of sitting on it
defects.expected: The buckle sits centred on the belt

defects.what: The big greeting text in the upper left draws the eye away from Santa
defects.expected: Any text is smaller or placed so Santa stays the main focus
